manifest.name: double_helix
manifest.intent: Move twenty drones as two counter-rotating strands winding upward around a shared vertical axis with generous collision clearance.
manifest.source:
def double_helix(params, swarm_pos, tstart, tend, limits):
    radius, turns, rise, gap = params
    n = swarm_pos.shape[0]
    out = swarm_pos.copy()
    lo = limits["lower"] * 100.0
    hi = limits["upper"] * 100.0
    cx = np.mean(swarm_pos[:, 0])
    cy = np.mean(swarm_pos[:, 1])
    cx = max(lo[0] + radius, min(hi[0] - radius, cx))
    cy = max(lo[1] + radius, min(hi[1] - radius, cy))
    margin = 0.5 * (rise + gap)
    cz = np.mean(swarm_pos[:, 2])
    cz = max(lo[2] + margin, min(hi[2] - margin, cz))
    duration = tend - tstart
    target = []
    for i in range(n):
        strand = i // 10
        j = i % 10
        angle = 2.0 * np.pi * j / 10.0
        z = cz + (0.5 * gap if strand == 0 else -0.5 * gap) - 0.5 * rise
        target.append(np.array([cx + radius * np.cos(angle), cy + radius * np.sin(angle), z]))
    waypoints = {}
    for step in range(25):
        s = 0.04 + 0.96 * step / 24.0
        if s < 0.40:
            v = (s - 0.04) / 0.36
            u = v * v * (3.0 - 2.0 * v)
        else:
            u = 1.0
        frame = {}
        for i in range(n):
            strand = i // 10
            j = i % 10
            direction = 1.0 if strand == 0 else -1.0
            angle = 2.0 * np.pi * j / 10.0 + direction * 2.0 * np.pi * turns * max(0.0, (s - 0.40) / 0.60)
            z = cz + rise * (max(0.0, (s - 0.40) / 0.60) - 0.5) + (0.5 * gap if strand == 0 else -0.5 * gap)
            helix = np.array([cx + radius * np.cos(angle), cy + radius * np.sin(angle), z])
            p = swarm_pos[i] * (1.0 - u) + helix * u
            frame[i] = p
            out[i] = p
        waypoints[tstart + duration * s] = frame
    return out, waypoints
manifest.invariants:
def check(pos, time, params):
    radius, turns, rise, gap = params
    mask = time >= time[0] + 0.40 * (time[-1] - time[0])
    q = pos[:, mask, :]
    axis = np.mean(q[:, :, :2], axis=0)
    d = q[:, :, :2] - axis[None, :, :]
    r = np.sqrt(np.sum(d * d, axis=2))
    radial_error = np.max(np.abs(r - radius))
    radial_ok = radial_error < 22.0
    radial_detail = "largest cylindrical-radius error %.1f cm" % radial_error
    minimum = 1000000.0
    for k in range(q.shape[1]):
        for i in range(10):
            dx = q[i, k, 0] - q[10:, k, 0]
            dy = q[i, k, 1] - q[10:, k, 1]
            dz = q[i, k, 2] - q[10:, k, 2]
            minimum = min(minimum, np.min(np.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)))
    clearance_ok = minimum > 50.0
    clearance_detail = "minimum cross-strand separation %.1f cm" % minimum
    means0 = np.mean(q[:10, :, 2], axis=1)
    means1 = np.mean(q[10:20, :, 2], axis=1)
    gap_error = np.max(np.abs((means0 - means1) - gap))
    gap_ok = gap_error < 20.0
    gap_detail = "largest inter-strand height-gap error %.1f cm" % gap_error
    sums0 = []
    sums1 = []
    for i in range(10):
        a = np.arctan2(d[i, :, 1], d[i, :, 0])
        b = np.arctan2(d[i + 10, :, 1], d[i + 10, :, 0])
        da = np.arctan2(np.sin(a[1:] - a[:-1]), np.cos(a[1:] - a[:-1]))
        db = np.arctan2(np.sin(b[1:] - b[:-1]), np.cos(b[1:] - b[:-1]))
        sums0.append(np.sum(da))
        sums1.append(np.sum(db))
    counter_ok = np.mean(sums0) > 0.05 and np.mean(sums1) < -0.05
    counter_detail = "angular sums %.2f and %.2f rad" % (np.mean(sums0), np.mean(sums1))
    return [("constant_radius", radial_ok, radial_detail), ("cross_strand_clearance", clearance_ok, clearance_detail), ("vertical_strand_gap", gap_ok, gap_detail), ("counter_rotation", counter_ok, counter_detail)]
